title: Gumball Plane Drag Preview Is Disk Inside Sphere
description: The preview of the drag in the gumball for a plane is currently covering the complete screen. Make sure only the disk inside the sphere is previewed.
summary:
Fixed gumball plane hover/drag preview covering the full viewport.

Root cause: GumballPlanePreviewMesh scaled a unit square to gumballPreviewWorldExtent every frame, so the plane fill stretched across the camera frustum.

Fix: Plane interaction preview is now a circleGeometry disk with radius GUMBALL_RING_RADIUS (the disk inside the gumball sphere). Axis line previews still use viewport extent.

Verified: UnifiedGumball math vitest passes (disk radius assertions added).
